Abracadabra doesn't mean what you think it means.

Kevin explains that the word has a Persian origin and means "I now create with my words." He says the ancient mystics understood the power of speech.

The takeaway is simple: words are not harmless noise. Kevin teaches that you should watch what comes out of your mouth, because speaking shapes how you move through life.

Which words do you use most when you talk about your own life?
